content.storyline: The Week 11 NFL Mexico City game pairs the 7-2 Vikings with the 8-1 49ers. Both are coming off Week 10 wins: Minnesota beat Green Bay 30-10, and San Francisco defeated Dallas 46-40.
matchup_notes: Minnesota beat Green Bay 30-10 in Week 10, snapping a two-game skid.
San Francisco beat Dallas 46-40 in Week 10; Brock Purdy threw for 389 yards and three touchdowns without an interception.
Minnesota leads the NFL with 37 defensive sacks.
The game is scheduled for Sunday, November 22, at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC in Mexico City.
